headline.text: L1 S2 almond clusters held after *metal detector* caught aluminum cup fragment — X-ray did not detect same piece.

summary: Two active holds — underweight pouches on L1 S2 (morning shift handoff issue, corrected by 08:00), and ongoing metal-in-product investigation on L1 S2 almond clusters where aluminum temper cup fragments entered the line. Metal detector rejected product successfully, but side-by-side testing confirmed X-ray failed to detect the same fragment. Hourly MD checks and enrober wash scheduled.

holds.title: S2 underweight pouches from overnight shift
holds.summary: Morning QA found pouches underweight (34–36 pieces vs. spec), insufficient decoration — operator reported receiving shift with these conditions and made adjustments.
holds.status: Resolved by 07:56 — weight, decoration, and count now within spec after operator adjustments. Previous pallets recommended for hold pending disposition.

food_safety.title: S2 metal-in-product — aluminum temper cup in almond clusters
food_safety.summary: Piece of aluminum temper cup found in product at 20:26 MT; cup incomplete with parts missing. Metal detector rejected successfully, but X-ray failed to detect same fragment in testing.
food_safety.status: Open — hourly MD checks in place, all rejected product retested 3× with no further hits by end of window. Team investigating who dropped cup. Enrober wash scheduled 3pm next day.

quality.title: S3 MM3 and MM5 pouch weights out of spec
quality.summary: Matrix 3 and Matrix 5 centerweight units producing pouches outside spec at shift start — neither machine matched target.
quality.status: Resolved — adjustments made to both machines, weights corrected and confirmed within spec by 07:50 MT.

Review X-ray sensitivity for thin aluminum — based on S2 side-by-side testing where metal detector caught cup fragment but X-ray did not.
